# Behavioral Pattern Skills

- [Chain of Responsibility](../chain-of-responsibility/SKILL.md): Pass a request through an ordered chain of handlers until processing is completed or rejected.
- [Command](../command/SKILL.md): Encapsulate a request as an object so it can be queued, logged, retried, authorized, or undone.
- [Iterator](../iterator/SKILL.md): Traverse a collection without exposing its internal representation.
- [Mediator](../mediator/SKILL.md): Centralize communication between collaborating components so they do not depend directly on one another.
- [Memento](../memento/SKILL.md): Capture and restore an object's internal state without exposing its representation.
- [Observer](../observer/SKILL.md): Notify multiple subscribers when a subject changes without tightly coupling the subject to concrete observers.
- [State](../state/SKILL.md): Change an object's behavior when its internal state changes by delegating state-specific behavior to state objects.
- [Strategy](../strategy/SKILL.md): Encapsulate interchangeable algorithms behind a common contract and select one independently from the client.
- [Template Method](../template-method/SKILL.md): Define the invariant skeleton of an algorithm while allowing subclasses to customize selected steps.
- [Visitor](../visitor/SKILL.md): Add operations to a stable object structure without modifying the element classes.
